description: List every peer review assigned on an assignment, across every submission, returning each review's id, assessor_id (the reviewer), user_id (the reviewee whose submission is being reviewed), asset_id, and workflow_state ('assigned' or 'completed'). Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating. Pass submission_id to scope the results to the reviews assigned to that one submission instead of the whole assignment — the same result get_submission_peer_reviews returns, kept here as a shortcut. Omit it to see every review across the assignment. Use create_peer_review to assign a new reviewer, and delete_peer_review to remove one.

submission_id.description: Optional Canvas submission ID. When provided, scopes results to the peer reviews assigned to this submission instead of every peer review on the assignment.

name: list_peer_reviews
title: List Peer Reviews
